features.name: checking_status_ordinal
features.description: Ordinal encoding of checking account status from worst to best: negative balance=0, no account=1, low balance=2, adequate balance=3
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a monotonic ordinal split on checking account health, enabling tree to find threshold-based splits on financial stability

features.name: savings_status_ordinal
features.description: Ordinal encoding of savings account status from lowest to highest: no savings=0, <100=1, 100-500=2, 500-1000=3, >=1000=4
features.expected_model_benefit: Enables direct threshold splits on savings wealth level, a strong predictor of creditworthiness
features.formula: np.where(savings_status == 'no known savings', 0, np.where(savings_status == '<100', 1, np.where(savings_status == '100<=X<500', 2, np.where(savings_status == '500<=X<1000', 3, 4))))

features.name: credit_history_risk_score
features.description: Risk score for credit history: no credits=0, all paid=1, delayed=2, existing paid=3, critical/other=4 (critical may indicate resourcefulness)
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts nominal credit history into an ordinal risk scale that tree models can split on directly
features.formula: np.where(credit_history == 'no credits/all paid', 0, np.where(credit_history == 'all paid', 1, np.where(credit_history == 'delayed previously', 2, np.where(credit_history == 'existing paid', 3, 4))))

features.name: monthly_payment_burden
features.description: Estimated monthly payment as credit_amount divided by duration, representing monthly financial obligation
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the monthly cash flow burden which is more informative than raw credit amount or duration alone; enables nonlinear interaction splits

features.name: installment_to_credit_ratio
features.description: Installment commitment rate multiplied by monthly payment burden, approximating total payment pressure as percentage of income proxy
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines installment rate with loan size to capture overall repayment stress; nonlinear interaction useful for tree splits

features.name: employment_stability_score
features.description: Ordinal employment stability: unemployed=0, <1 year=1, 1-4 years=2, 4-7 years=3, >=7 years=4
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts employment duration categories into a stability scale enabling direct threshold splits on job security

features.name: high_risk_purpose_flag
features.description: Binary flag indicating high-risk loan purposes: new car, education, retraining=1; otherwise=0
features.expected_model_benefit: Boolean indicator for purposes historically associated with higher default risk, enabling direct boolean splits

features.name: financial_vulnerability_index
features.description: Composite vulnerability score combining negative checking status, low savings, and high installment commitment into a single risk index
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates multiple financial stress signals into one feature, enabling tree to find compound risk thresholds efficiently
features.formula: np.where(checking_status == '<0', 2, np.where(checking_status == '0<=X<200', 1, 0)) + np.where(savings_status == '<100', 2, np.where(savings_status == 'no known savings', 1, 0)) + np.where(installment_commitment >= 3, 2, np.where(installment_commitment == 2, 1, 0))

features.name: log_credit_amount
features.description: Log-transformed credit amount to compress right-skewed distribution and enable better threshold splits on loan size
features.expected_model_benefit: Log transformation reduces skewness of credit_amount, allowing tree splits to better separate small vs large loans

features.name: age_employment_interaction
features.description: Product of age and employment stability score, capturing the combined effect of life stage and career stability on creditworthiness
features.expected_model_benefit: Nonlinear interaction between age and employment tenure; young unemployed vs older stable employed creates meaningful splits

features.name: collateral_strength_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of collateral quality based on property_magnitude and housing: real estate owner=4, life insurance owner=3, car owner=2, renter with property=1, no property/renting=0
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures asset backing quality as a single ordinal score; tree can split on collateral threshold to separate secured vs unsecured risk profiles

features.name: overall_creditworthiness_profile
features.description: Holistic semantic score (0-10) combining checking account health, savings level, employment stability, credit history, and loan purpose risk into a unified creditworthiness signal
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a single composite score that tree models can use as a primary split, capturing multi-dimensional credit risk in one feature
